name: Bohicon
pointBasis: Exact WUP2025 population-weighted settlement point in latitude/longitude order; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official ANDF National Cadastre viewer and its public GeoServer WFS returned anonymous parcel polygons whose commune and arrondissement attributes identify BOHICON / BOHICON II. The official Mairie de Bohicon site was separately checked for local services but did not expose a public parcel geometry endpoint.
technicalBlocker: Anonymous geometry and native spatial-unit identities were verified, but citywide completeness, authoritative identity persistence, and adapter behavior remain for serial review.
scopeLimits: Three full polygons were retained from a small anonymous WFS bbox around the exact WUP point. This is not evidence of citywide completeness or absence outside the queried extent. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or other unsafe identity fields were retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official ANDF national cadastre viewer backed by GeoServer WFS layer efb:efb_parcel.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three polygons returned from a bounded Bohicon-area WFS query; exact-point-sized bbox also returned three intersecting features.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Serial reviewer must independently qualify source-native identity, coverage, CRS, and adapter behavior. Packet completion is not source integration/admission.

queries.executionMethod: Separate fresh web search in French; no login or bypass was used.

200; three polygons returned in a small bbox surrounding the exact WUP point; no coordinate shift was used.

portals.observation: Official local municipal portal; services reviewed separately from national geometry service.
Current public API endpoint discovered from viewer JavaScript and inspected directly.

nativeIdentity: BJ.LA.SpatialUnit namespace plus spatial_unit_oid_local_id, recorded as a composite source-native identity string. The WFS feature id was unstable/repeated across returned rows and was not used.
schemaAndCrs: WFS 1.0.0 layer efb:efb_parcel, geometry type Polygon, advertised source SRS EPSG:32631; requests used srsName=EPSG:4326 and retained GeoJSON lon/lat coordinates.

fieldMapping.retained feature properties: Exactly properties.id, composed from spatial_unit_oid_namespace and spatial_unit_oid_local_id; no raw source attributes retained.
fieldMapping.composite-key provenance: Source itself supplied namespace BJ.LA.SpatialUnit and local spatial_unit_oid_local_id; concatenation with ':' is only the canonical retained identity representation.

retainedProperties: Exactly one canonical native identity per feature: properties.id.
unsafeDataPolicy: No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal/property-record fields were requested as selected output or retained. The bounded default WFS response was reduced before retention.
limits: The WUP point is preserved exactly in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted to force a hit.
The exact small bbox returned nearby/intersecting polygons; this does not establish parcel coverage at every point or citywide completeness.
The municipal site evidences a local portal but not a city-hosted cadastral API; national ANDF/GeoServer is the geometry custodian evidenced here.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.
uncertainty: The public service is strong bounded geometry evidence and identifies Bohicon administrative context, but service-wide coverage, identity stability over time, and adapter semantics require serial review.
